_comment: Optional CONFIG-side patch for the Rippers/Guild register skin. The CSS skin handles the whole LOOK (palette, Pirata/Grenze/Plex type, geometry, hidden Korean) on its own; this file re-words the shop's DOM-bound flavour copy (config.themeData) to neutral 1892 register text AND flips the shop public (see publicShop below). Apply by hand in Shop Settings, or paste into the shop's config. It invents no lore — it sets the sourced date, a register purse label, and clears the demo Korean/Japanese labels. Fuller register prose (board header, subheader, seals, signature) is Austin's to write — field names listed under _themeDataFields. NOTE: this does NOT change the currency SYMBOL (10z -> pence/sterling); that is a world-level GlitchSmith currency setting — see _currency_manual below and the README.
_publicShop_note: Top-level shopConfig flag (NOT themeData). Makes the shop appear in the player-facing Shop Directory + GlitchSmith shop browser so players can browse and buy it themselves — the owner ruled players should browse. SAFE to carry in a preset because a preset only takes effect when a GM DELIBERATELY applies it to a specific shop (a per-shop GM action), so it grants nothing automatically and changes no actor ownership/permissions. Players also need to own a buyer PC, and a GM must be online at purchase time (Stylish Shop runs transactions through the active GM). See the README 'Make shops visible to players' section.
_currency_manual: The shop quotes prices in the currency's own symbol/format, which comes from the GlitchSmith Library currency DEFINITION (a world setting), NOT from this shop's config — so the theme module/preset cannot reach it. The ruling (lodge-docs/CURRENCY-zenit-and-sterling.md) is 1 zenit = 1 penny. To make the shop quote 1892 sterling: in the world's GlitchSmith currency config, set the zenit currency's symbol to 'd' (pence) so '10z' reads '10d'; or define zenit as a compound penny/shilling/pound currency (12d=1s, 240d=£1) for full £/s/d display. The sheet stays in zenit either way (the ruling: the world quotes sterling, the sheet quotes zenit).
_note_korean: The .cat-kr / .cn-kr / .row-kr / .kr sublabels are hidden by the CSS skin regardless; clearing navHeadKr here is belt-and-suspenders for config cleanliness. walletLabel/walletChipId shown here are the test-world demo values (ギルド残高 / Member №42); in a real world they are whatever the GM set, so the skin never overwrites them — this preset only offers register defaults.
_note_fonts: Fonts need no preset: with the shop's default (empty) fontOverrides, the CSS names Pirata/Grenze/Plex directly. Only set config.fontOverrides['grid-guild'] if you want the config path to own the type law instead of the stylesheet.
